title: Aggregate low-value hotpath spans and introduce SLO-feedback sampling controller
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Hotpath tracer overhead is increasing under QPS growth (observed +18% CPU on inference-proxy P95 traffic). Existing prefilters and probabilistic samplers reduce volume but still incur allocation and locking costs for every request. Goal: reduce tracer hotpath cost by (1) merging/aggregating repeated low-information spans into compact 'summary spans' at emit time, and (2) add an SLO-feedback sampling controller that dynamically budgets sampling per-tenant/route based on latency/error SLOs. We must preserve tail fidelity for routes with regression signals and keep exemplar spans for post-hoc debugging. Design: implement a lightweight in-process span-aggregator that keeps a fixed-size ring of recent span signatures for each worker thread. For high-frequency low-variance spans (same op name + small set of tags), aggregator collapses them into a summary object with counters and sample exemplars rather than emitting full span objects. The SLO-feedback controller consumes latency/error metrics (route P95, error-rate) from the local metrics cache and adjusts per-tenant token-bucket budgets that gate whether the aggregator emits full exemplars vs only increments summaries. Trade-offs: aggregation reduces emission rate and allocations but can hide rare correlated errors if exemplar selection is too aggressive. To mitigate this we reserve an exemplar budget and split it into periodic and anomaly-triggered buckets. Implementation steps: (1) Introduce TracerAggregator module behind feature flag, with deterministic summary keying (op name + normalized tags hash) and exemplar reservoir sampling of size N=3 per key. (2) Implement SLOFeedbackController service that polls route metrics at 1s cadence and adjusts per-route token-buckets. (3) Add fast-path zero-alloc code paths: use an arena-style pool for summary objects, lock-free per-thread ring via sequence counters, and avoid JSON pathing in hotpath. (4) Expose metrics: aggregated_spans_total, full_spans_emitted, exemplar_rate, merged_span_loss_estimate, controller_budget_usage. (5) Add dashboard panels and alert thresholds. Backwards compatibility: aggregator is opt-in per environment/route; when disabled tracer reverts to current sampler pipeline. Rollout plan: start with dev environments, then small prod cohort with non-critical routes, watch tail metrics and errors for 72h before broader rollout.
comments: 2025-03-10 - Maya Chen: Initial RFC posted to Confluence (see attachment). Proposed aggregator algorithm and SLO controller. Measured baseline on staging: 12% CPU hotpath from tracing, ~45k spans/s emitted from proxy under load test.

2025-03-12 - Liam O'Connor: Spike implemented a prototype aggregator in the tracer shim. Local load test reduced emitted span count by 78% for high-QPS route and reduced allocation rate by ~62k allocs/s. Observed a regression in tracer mutex contention when exemplar reservoir used global lock; switched to per-thread reservoirs to remove contention.

2025-03-13 - Design review: Agreed to keep exemplar reservoir size small (N=3) per summary and to reserve 1/10th of exemplar budget for anomaly-triggered retention. Decision: anomaly detection based on delta in P95 and error-rate compared to 10m rolling baseline.

2025-03-14 - Perf regression found: initial arena implementation caused slower frees under heavy churn. Fix applied: use a lock-free freelist with epoch reclamation for worker-local arenas. Re-ran benchmarks: latency impact eliminated, CPU on hotpath down by 9% absolute.

2025-03-15 - QA: Added CI microbenchmark that simulates 200k requests/s and verifies aggregator correctness (merged counts + exemplar sampling). One flaky test observed around reservoir reseed; added deterministic RNG seeding in test harness.

2025-03-16 - Ops: Dashboard panels created in Grafana: 'Tracing: aggregated vs full spans', 'Exemplar budget usage', and 'Merged span loss estimate'. Added alert if merged_span_loss_estimate > 0.5% for >10m on any production route.

2025-03-17 - Next: Implement rollout toggle in Console (per-route flag), add canary policy that keeps 1% full-span sampling on canary routes, and create runbook for investigating missed-exemplar cases. Schedule post-rollout retrospective after 2 weeks.
